title: View and Add New Tasks
user_story: As a user, I want to see an input field and a list area on the page, so that I can quickly add new items to my to-do list.
acceptance_criteria: The page loads with a text input box and an Add button visible at the top.
Typing text into the input and clicking Add or pressing Enter creates a new task item in the list below.
The input field clears automatically after successfully adding a task.
Submitting an empty input does not create a blank task.

title: Mark Tasks Complete or Delete Them
user_story: As a user, I want to check off finished tasks or remove unwanted ones, so that my list stays organized and reflects only what needs attention.
acceptance_criteria: Each task in the list displays a clickable checkbox or toggle control.
Clicking the checkbox marks the task as complete by applying a visual change like strikethrough text or moving it to a completed section.
A delete button next to each task permanently removes it from the view when clicked.
All changes appear instantly without requiring a page refresh.

title: Save Tasks Locally for Future Sessions
user_story: As a user, I want my tasks to remain saved if I close and reopen the browser tab, so that I do not lose my progress between visits.
acceptance_criteria: Adding, completing, or deleting tasks automatically saves the current list state in the browser's local storage.
Refreshing the page or reopening the application restores all previously added tasks with their exact completion status.
No account creation, login, or external server setup is required to save data.
